verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a document-processing SaaS and SDK. However, the evidence pack never mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out setting. Related privacy material (dedicated VPC instances, IP allowlisting, SOC 2/GDPR compliance) is adjacent and does not show a telemetry opt-out control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
